messages:
Jamal Khan (Sales): Quick handoff — HelioThera (clinical trials platform). ARR $180k, 12-mo commitment, go-live target 2026-05-12. Primary contacts: Priya (prod mgr) priya@heliothera.com, CTO: Marco. Key ask: CS to own onboarding, run enablement, and coordinate SSO + data ingest with Support/Eng. Notes: using private deployment (VPC), need SOC2 docs, customer wants SSO (SAML) and a lighter batch-embedding pipeline. Current blockers: legal reviewing DPA (expected 1 week), security review scheduled 2026-04-01. Also flagged potential renewal risk if onboarding delays >30 days.
Maria Lin (CSM): Thanks Jamal — assigning to me. I'll schedule kickoff for the week of 2026-04-06. Quick Q: do we have GCP project IDs and a contact for infra? Also any compliance artifacts already shared?
Jamal Khan (Sales): GCP project: heliothera-prod (will share IAM contact — Marco). I uploaded their SOC2 summary and a redacted network diagram to the deal folder: https://drive.redwood/heliothera/deal-docs. Legal DPA notes: they requested data residency clause; sales escalated to legal.
Maria Lin (CSM): Got it. I'll request access to the drive and loop in security. Tentative onboarding plan: Kickoff -> SSO setup -> Private deploy checklist -> Integrations & ingest -> Training -> Validation (2-week window). I'll create an onboarding playbook doc and share before kickoff.
Sarah Ng (Enablement): I'll own the enablement sessions: 2x 90-min workshops (platform overview + embedding pipelines) and an admin Q&A. Suggest we prep a 1-pager on best-practice batch/streaming ingest for their use case. @Maria Lin (CSM) can you confirm dataset size expectations?
Maria Lin (CSM): They indicated ~1.2TB raw clinical notes, nightly batches + real-time alerts. We'll recommend initial pilot on a 100GB subset. Also raising an action: need ETA on SSO metadata and SAML cert from their IDP.
Oliver Choi (Support Eng): I'll take SSO + private deploy tasks. Please open a support ticket with stack details and attach network diagram + VPC peering contact. For SAML we need IdP metadata XML and ACS URL. My checklist:
- Ticket with VPC CIDR + peering contact
- SAML metadata + attribute mappings
- Service account email for deploy
- Expected peak qps and batch window
You can paste quick test curl for health check in the ticket, e.g., `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://heliothera.internal.redwood/health`.
Maria Lin (CSM): Opening ticket now and linking this thread. Ticket: SUP-2026-3427. Attached: drive link, network diagram, SOC2 summary. @Oliver Choi can you confirm estimated eng effort/time to complete SSO & private deploy prep?
Oliver Choi (Support Eng): Rough estimate: SSO + access config ~1-2 business days once metadata + certs are provided; private deploy prep (network, service account, deploy dry-run) ~3-5 biz days. If legal/security back-and-forth extends, timeline shifts.
Maria Lin (CSM): Noted. I'll make SSO metadata the first deliverable from HelioThera in kickoff. Also flagged: renewal risk if go-live slips past 2026-06-15. I'll set health check milestones and track in Gainsight.
Jamal Khan (Sales): Good call on deadlines. Sales will nudge legal to expedite DPA; I can introduce Marco to our security PO tomorrow. Also logging customer sentiment: excited but anxious about compliance — consider proactive check-ins.
Sarah Ng (Enablement): I'll prepare a short feedback capture form for after training and a success metrics doc (engagement, latency targets, cost per inference). Will share drafts by 2026-04-03.
Maria Lin (CSM): Next steps (owners): 1) Kickoff invite — Maria (by 2026-03-29), 2) Create support ticket & attach docs — Maria (done), 3) SSO metadata from customer — Priya/Marco (customer), 4) SSO/config work — Oliver, 5) Enablement sessions — Sarah, 6) Legal DPA follow-up — Jamal. I'll update thread with kickoff invite and onboarding playbook link.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Support ticket SUP-2026-3427 assigned to Oliver Choi. SLA timer started (72h) — https://support.redwood/tickets/SUP-2026-3427
Maria Lin (CSM): Kickoff scheduled: 2026-04-06 16:00 PT — calendar invite sent to Priya, Marco, Jamal, Oliver, Sarah. Playbook draft: https://docs.redwood/onboarding/heliothera-playbook (wip). I'll post status updates here after kickoff. :thumbsup:
